name: Missing Meta Description
description: User has a page with no meta description. Skill should identify the issue and provide recommendations.
userMessage: Can you check the SEO of https://example.com/blog/my-first-post? I think something might be wrong with the search snippet.
expectedBehavior: Identifies missing meta description as a High severity issue
Explains the impact on CTR and search appearance
Suggests a meta description following the 150-160 character rule
Recommends including a call-to-action in the description
